response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm tired of the same old suits of armor and banners. I want something new, something... futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
Futuristic, Your Majesty? But this is the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
Exactly! That's what I mean. We need to blend the old with the new. The ancient with the avant-garde.

JESTER PIPER
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. But how do you propose we achieve this?

KING REGINALD
Leave that to me. I've been studying the art of... vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
Vaporwave? But that's a music genre, Your Majesty!

KING REGINALD
Ah, yes. But it's also a aesthetic. A way of life. And I intend to bring it to our kingdom.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

KING REGINALD is surrounded by a team of courtiers, who are frantically trying to create a vaporwave-inspired makeover for the kingdom.

COURTIER 1
Your Majesty, we're having trouble finding the right fabrics. The velvet and satin just aren't... retro-futuristic enough.

KING REGINALD
Try the polyester, then. And don't forget the neon.

COURTIER 2
But, Your Majesty, the peasants might not appreciate the... avant-garde aesthetic.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense! The peasants will love it. They'll be the first to adopt the latest in vaporwave fashion.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The suits of armor are replaced with neon-lit, mirrored helmets. The banners are replaced with holographic projections. The peasants are dressed in polyester jumpsuits with built-in cassette players.

KING REGINALD
(to the courtiers)
It's perfect! The kingdom is now a true proto-vaporwave empire.

JESTER PIPER
But, Your Majesty, what about the knights? They look... out of place.

KING REGINALD
Leave that to me. I've instructed them to wear... distressed denim and oversized sweatshirts.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - LATER

The kingdom is in full swing. The peasants are dancing to the beat of vaporwave music, while the knights look on in confusion.

KING REGINALD
(to the courtiers)
It's working! The kingdom is now a true hub of proto-vaporwave culture.

COURTIER 1
But, Your Majesty, what about the aesthetics? It's all so... garish.

KING REGINALD
Garish? Ha! That's the point. We're pushing the boundaries of fashion and art. We're creating a new language, a new way of life.

JESTER PIPER
And what about the future, Your Majesty? Will this vaporwave aesthetic bring prosperity to our kingdom?

KING REGINALD
Prosperity? Ha! We'll be the envy of all the other kingdoms. We'll be the pioneers of proto-vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - LATER

The kingdom is thriving. The peasants are dancing in the streets, while the knights look on in confusion. The king, surrounded by his courtiers, smiles proudly.

KING REGINALD
(to the courtiers)
It's working. We're the pioneers of proto-vaporwave.

COURTIER 2
But, Your Majesty, what about the critics? The ones who say we're abandoning our medieval heritage?

KING REGINALD
Critics? Ha! We're not just abandoning our heritage, we're... redefining it. We're creating a new language, a new way of life.

JESTER PIPER
And what about the future, Your Majesty? Will this vaporwave aesthetic bring peace to our kingdom?

KING REGINALD
Peace? Ha! We'll be the most peaceful kingdom in all the land. We'll be the pioneers of... proto-vaporwave utopia.

FADE TO BLACK.
